items: 🔄 Detachable 2-in-1 Tablet PC Design - The Lenovo IdeaPad D330 features a flexible detachable 2-in-1 design, allowing you to use it as a tablet PC or lightweight laptop with keyboard. Perfect for students, travel, remote work, note-taking, and everyday use, this portable tablet computer offers versatile functionality.

🖥️ 10.1" Touchscreen Display for Easy Interaction - Equipped with a 10.1-inch HD touchscreen (1280 x 800), this touchscreen tablet provides responsive touch control for browsing, streaming, reading, note-taking, and light productivity tasks. Ideal as a student tablet or portable Windows tablet device.

⚡ Efficient Performance for Daily Tasks - Powered by Intel Celeron N4000 processor with 4GB RAM, this Windows tablet PC is designed for web browsing, email, online classes, Microsoft Office, and light multitasking. A great choice for users needing an affordable entry-level laptop alternative.

💾 64GB SSD Storage with Windows 11 Pro - Comes with 64GB SSD storage for fast boot times and smooth system performance. Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, this compact tablet computer is suitable for school, home office, and business basic tasks.

🌏 Japanese Keyboard & USB-C Connectivity - Includes a Japanese keyboard, making it ideal for users who prefer JIS layout. Features USB Type-C connectivity for charging and data transfer, enhancing usability for modern accessories. This portable 2-in-1 tablet laptop is designed for convenience and mobility.
